💷 Chancellor Healey is eyeing a windfall tax on Britain's banks after the big four booked £29.2bn in profits in just six months. With a £22bn fiscal hole to plug, banks are the latest target.

Bank taxes always get passed on, in mortgage costs, savings rates and pension returns. Another emergency raid won't fix spending Labour won't control.
